description: React component implementing a ticket check-in scanner UI, handling input, API calls, and displaying scan results and history.

methods.name: onScan
methods.description: Handles the scan action, sending request to API, updating state with result or error, and maintaining scan history.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Returns CSS classes for status badge color based on success, duplicate, invalid, or default.

methods.name: getStatusIcon
methods.description: Returns icon for scan status: success, duplicate, invalid, or default.
